name: The Nurse Tarot Card Holographic Stickers (3 Pack)
seoTitle: Nurse Tarot Card Holographic Sticker Set
metaDescription: Three holographic tarot card stickers starring a skeleton nurse, a small and funny gift for nurses who like their humor a little dark and a little witchy.
summary: A tiny, offbeat gift for the nurse who reads tarot, loves Halloween, or just appreciates a skeleton in scrubs. Easy to tuck into a card or a stocking.
whyItWorks: Nurses tend to have a sense of humor that outsiders find a little grim, and a skeleton nurse drawn as a tarot card leans right into that. It reads as an inside joke about the job: the long nights, the strange things that happen at 3 a.m., the feeling that the universe has a plan for your shift that nobody shared with you. A holographic finish catches the light under fluorescent hallway bulbs, so it gets noticed.

Since it is a set of three, the gift stretches further than it looks. One can go on a work water bottle, one on a laptop used for charting classes or scheduling, and one can be handed to a coworker who will appreciate it. Stickers are also a low pressure present. They suit a new coworker you do not know well yet, a Halloween treat for the night crew, or an add on to a bigger gift like a tumbler or a badge reel.
goodToKnow: The title lists the stickers at about 3 inches, so they suit bottles and laptops better than car windows.
Check the listing photos to confirm all three designs, since the title only describes the theme.
Pair it with a plain insulated tumbler so the stickers have a home right away.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse who is not into tarot?
faq.a: Usually yes, since the joke lands as a skeleton nurse gag more than a spiritual item. If the recipient dislikes spooky themes, a cheerful sticker pack would be a safer pick.

faq.q: Can these go on a water bottle that gets washed?
faq.a: Vinyl stickers generally hold up better than paper ones, but check the listing for care notes and hand washing advice before putting one on a bottle that goes through a dishwasher.
